title: When is Fine-Tuning Scalable? Certified Recovery from Noisy Data and Linear-Cost Fine-Tuning on Structured Task Shifts
abstract: arXiv:2509.00924v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Transformers often transfer across related tasks with little fine-tuning; we study this question in noisy nonparametric regression for continuous maps $f,g:[0,1]^d\to\mathbb{R}^D$, representing the source and shifted tasks, using a single-query, single-head transformer $\mathcal{T}(\cdot)=V\operatorname{Softmax}(-\alpha(\cdot,K))$ with $\ell^{\infty}$-based alignment scores $\alpha$. Rather than assume that gradient-based training reaches an empirical risk minimizer, we give a model-specific two-stage procedure \textbf{certifying} source-task recovery and out-of-distribution (OOD) adaptation. With high probability, the resulting attention head recovers $f$ to arbitrary accuracy $\varepsilon>0$ in every fixed $L^p([0,1]^d)$ norm, $1\le p<\infty$, from noisy observations. translated_title: 微调何时具有可扩展性？基于噪声数据的可认证恢复与结构化任务偏移下的线性成本微调
translated_abstract: Transformer模型通常只需少量微调即可在相关任务之间进行迁移；我们在噪声非参数回归设定中研究这一问题，考虑表示源任务与偏移任务的连续映射 $f,g:[0,1]^d\to\mathbb{R}^D$，并使用具有基于 $\ell^{\infty}$ 对齐分数 $\alpha$ 的单查询、单头Transformer $\mathcal{T}(\cdot)=V\operatorname{Softmax}(-\alpha(\cdot,K))$。我们并不假设基于梯度的训练能够达到经验风险最小化器，而是给出了一个模型特定的两阶段过程，用于**认证**源任务恢复与分布外（OOD）适应能力。在高概率下，所得到的注意力头能够从带噪观测中以任意精度 $\varepsilon>0$、在每个固定的 $L^p([0,1]^d)$ 范数（$1\le p<\infty$）下恢复 $f$。对于Lipschitz目标，其收敛速率在对数因子意义下达到极小极大最优，且无需假设可以访问渐近经验风险最小化器的预言机。若 $D=1$ 且 $f$ 为Pfaffian函数，则……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一个模型特定的两阶段认证程序，证明单头Transformer在结构化任务偏移下仅需线性成本的微调，即可从噪声数据中以极小极大最优速率可认证地恢复源任务并实现分布外适应。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a model-specific two-stage certifying procedure showing that a single-head transformer, with only linear-cost fine-tuning, provably recovers the source task from noisy data at a minimax-optimal rate and achieves certified out-of-distribution adaptation under structured task shifts.
